segments.name: Insurance Operations
segments.description: Provides homeowners' property and casualty insurance, primarily in Florida and other northeast and southeast U.S. states, through HCPCI and TTIC.
segments.evidence: We currently have two operating property and casualty insurance subsidiaries: Homeowners Choice Property & Casualty Insurance Company, Inc. ("HCPCI") and TTIC.

segments.name: Exzeo
products: Turn-key insurance technology and operations solutions
Purpose-built software and data analytics applications
segments.description: Majority-owned subsidiary providing insurance technology and operations solutions for the property and casualty insurance ecosystem.
segments.evidence: Exzeo provides turn-key insurance technology and operations solutions based on a proprietary platform of purpose-built software and data analytics applications that are specifically designed for the property and casualty insurance ecosystem.

segments.name: Reciprocal Exchange Operations
segments.description: Manages consolidated reciprocal insurance exchanges owned by their policyholders, providing AIF services such as administration, underwriting and claims adjusting.
segments.evidence: We also provide attorney-in-fact ("AIF") services for reciprocal insurance exchanges owned by their policyholders.

segments.name: Real Estate
segments.description: Develops and operates commercial properties for investment purposes or for the company's own use, leasing space to unaffiliated tenants.
segments.evidence: we have a commercial real estate group that is primarily engaged in the business of developing and operating commercial properties for investment purposes or for our own use.

segments.name: Corporate and Other
segments.description: Comprises the holding company and other operations that do not meet reportable segment thresholds, including AIF services to reciprocal insurance exchanges.
segments.evidence: Corporate and Other is comprised of our holding company, HCI Group, Inc., plus other operations that do not meet the quantitative and qualitative thresholds for a reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Policyholders pay premiums for homeowners' property and casualty insurance, tenants pay rent on leased commercial properties, and reciprocal insurance exchanges pay for attorney-in-fact and technology services.
revenueModel.evidence: Except for the undeveloped land, we generate income from our investment properties by leasing vacancies to unaffiliated tenants.

changes.text: In July 2024, TypTap Insurance Company was transferred from Exzeo to HCI Group, Inc. to align all insurance operations under a single operating structure.
changes.evidence: July 2024 – TypTap Insurance Company ("TTIC"), a property and casualty insurance carrier subsidiary, was transferred from Exzeo to HCI Group, Inc.

changes.text: In February 2024, Condo Owners Reciprocal Exchange, a consolidated reciprocal insurance exchange providing commercial residential multiple peril insurance, commenced business operations.
changes.evidence: February 2024 – Condo Owners Reciprocal Exchange ("CORE"), a consolidated reciprocal insurance exchange which provides commercial residential multiple peril insurance, commenced business operations.

changes.text: In February 2025, Tailrow Insurance Exchange, a consolidated reciprocal insurance exchange specializing in fire and homeowners multiple peril insurance, commenced business operations.
changes.evidence: February 2025 – Tailrow Insurance Exchange ("Tailrow"), a consolidated reciprocal insurance exchange which specializes in fire and homeowners multiple peril insurance, commenced business operations.
